title: Gargi Flow Experiment Definition
description: Version 1 Experiment Definition Schema for Gargi Flow

apiVersion.description: API Version for the experiment schema definition

search.description: exhaustive enumerates every reduced deterministic policy; exact solves each world's optimal table policy by backward induction over information sets (discrete, perfect-recall models); grid evaluates every combination of the params of policy; random evaluates samples random draws of them; racing evaluates candidate policies with successive halving and paired confidence intervals; bayesian uses TPE over continuous and integer params

policy.description: The parameterized policy/v1 document varied by grid and random search, relative to the experiment; required for those searches and forbidden otherwise

samples.description: Number of random draws; required for search: random and forbidden otherwise. Draws with an identical policy id are evaluated once

seed.description: Seed of the random draws of search: random (default: the experiment seed); forbidden otherwise

min_runs.description: Initial number of runs per candidate policy in racing search

max_runs.description: Maximum number of runs per candidate policy in racing search

factor.description: Run budget multiplier per successive halving round in racing search

alpha.description: Significance level for paired difference confidence intervals in racing search

trials.description: Total parameter configurations to evaluate in bayesian search

startup_trials.description: Initial random exploration trials in bayesian search

gamma.description: Quantile threshold splitting good vs bad evaluations in bayesian search

racing.description: When true, composes candidate evaluations with racing

candidates.description: Candidate policy source specification for racing search

max_policies.description: Maximum number of policies enumerated by policies.search: exhaustive and of candidates of policies.search: grid; ignored by policies.search: exact and random

reports.description: Decision-quality reports: regret (policy tuned for each world evaluated in every world), robust (best by expected value under world_prior, maximin and CVaR), pareto:<metricA>[:min|max],<metricB>[:min|max] (per-world non-dominated set; goals default to max), voi:<node> (optimal EV with the node observed minus without it, its cost removed), flip_point:<param>[:<lo>,<hi>] (where the first world's optimal policy changes as a numeric world param is swept; default range: the param's minimum and maximum across the worlds), path_heatmap (probability of every node and edge under each world's best policy) and policy_tree (each world's optimal policy as a tree of information sets). regret and robust need at least two worlds; voi, flip_point and policy_tree need a discrete model

world_prior.description: Probability of each experiment world for the robust report; values sum to 1, omitted worlds get 0. Absent means uniform over the experiment's worlds

cvar_alpha.description: Tail mass of the robust report's CVaR criterion
